inputs.localBinaryFile: Local binary file up to 2 MiB

features.byteEditing: Hex byte editing with a read-only ASCII preview

limits.localFilesOnly: Local files only; no network upload

detailed_description: Use this free online hex editor to open a local binary file up to 2 MiB and inspect it in a paged 16-byte grid with zero-padded offsets. Edit hex bytes, review the read-only printable-ASCII preview, search the full file with hex byte pairs or ASCII text, reset changes, and download a modified copy; all file processing stays in the browser with no upload. The built-in text converter handles text to hex and hex to text for UTF-8 hex byte pairs, which is handy for encoding checks, binary inspection, and debugging serialized payloads. Byte edits are applied to the in-memory copy only; the original file is never touched and every change is visible in the byte grid before you download.
usage_steps: 1. Choose a local file no larger than 2 MiB.
2. Edit a two-digit hex byte and review the derived ASCII preview.
3. Search with hex byte pairs or ASCII text and use Previous or Next.
4. Check the modified-byte count or reset all changes.
5. Download the modified copy, or switch to Text Converter for UTF-8 conversion.
usage_examples: Inspect a small binary fixture and change one known byte.
Find repeated ASCII headers, move between matches, and save a modified copy.
Convert a UTF-8 hex string back to readable text to verify an encoded payload.
Change a checksum byte in a fixture and confirm the ASCII preview reflects the edit.

faqs.question: Are files uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. File reading, editing, search, reset, and download happen locally in the browser.

faqs.question: What is the file limit?
faqs.answer: The pilot accepts local files up to and including 2 MiB.

faqs.question: Can byte edits break a file?
faqs.answer: Yes. Arbitrary byte changes can make a file unusable, so keep the original and validate the modified copy in the application that owns the format.

faqs.question: Which text encoding is used?
faqs.answer: The Text Converter uses UTF-8 for text-to-hex and hex-to-text conversion.

faqs.question: Can I convert text to hex and back?
faqs.answer: Yes. Text Converter mode turns UTF-8 text into hex byte pairs (text to hex) and decodes hex byte pairs back into readable text (hex to text).
